citations.P1: `services/reconciler/reconcile.py:64` still reads `total_cents` and `"paid"` and will KeyError on the new shape, and the in-repo portal client (`useInvoice.ts:23`, `InvoiceBadge.tsx:9`) breaks too
citations.P3: Inserting `Disputed` before `Paid` renumbers Paid 2→3 and Void 3→4 in a numeric enum persisted to the SMALLINT `invoices.state` column, so every existing Paid row reads as Disputed
citations.P4: Prod and staging Helm values still set `INVOICE_GRACE_DAYS` at 21 and 14. After merge zod drops the unknown key and prod silently falls to a 7-day grace period.
citations.P5: `services/notifier/src/reminders.ts:57` still calls the old positional signature ... `--filter='[origin/main]'` skips dependents, which is why notifier and scripts never typechecked or ran
citations.P6: The "serializes a paid invoice" test was hollowed out to `toBeTruthy` and `toBeDefined` and cannot catch a wrong label or amount. Assert `'settled'`, `'125.00'`, and `'GBP'` exactly.
citations.P7: The compatibility claim in the description is contradicted by the author's own sweep.
citations.P8: The shape and "settled" changes also ship on the `billing.invoice.updated` event via events.ts, which the description does not mention. Audit event consumers or version the event
citations.P9: or emit the old fields alongside the new ones for a deprecation window
citations.P10: Rerun with `--filter='...[origin/main]'` or a full run before merge.
citations.P11: The GET route omits `rateBps`, so the displayed `late_fee_cents` uses the hard-coded 150 while dunning charges `LATE_FEE_RATE_BPS`.
